as_told.title: Hugh Everett worked for the Pentagon on nuclear game theory

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a physicist named Hugh Everett, who came up with the "many worlds" theory, the idea that every possible outcome plays out in its own branch of reality. Michels says that Everett then went to work for the Pentagon, the US military's headquarters, on game theory, the math of strategic decisions, as it applied to America's nuclear weapons. He tells it to show that a mind behind one of physics' strangest ideas ended up inside the defense world.
